messages.subject: Stecon Group | Infrastructure, digital growth and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Stecon Group Leadership Team,

Stecon Group's expansion across transportation infrastructure, airports, railways, data centers and other high-growth platforms aligns closely with the environment in which I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation. I work directly with ministries, regulators, communities and technical teams on high-scrutiny investment and operating matters.

My recent experience includes stakeholder and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-data readiness, multi-agency approvals and executive issue management. I would bring Stecon Group a country-facing leader who understands how major projects advance when institutional trust, operating discipline and sustainability move together.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached a Stecon Group-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
